payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates through a hardcoded list of lucky numbers (4,7,47,74,744,477) checking n % i; returns YES if any remainder zero.
payload.rationale: No search algorithm is used; the solution directly checks divisibility against a fixed set. Since all candidate subtypes are specific search methods, search_backtracking is selected as the default but it does not apply. Family complete_search is applicable loosely because it involves examining all candidates from a small set.
